arxiv-1802-03109.title: Understanding Chatbot-mediated Task Management
arxiv-1802-03109.creator: Carlos Toxtli Andrés Monroy-Hernández Justin Cranshaw
arxiv-1802-03109.description: Abstract Effective task management is essential to successful team collaboration. While the past decade has seen considerable innovation in systems that track and manage group tasks, these innovations have typically been outside of the principal communication channels: email, instant messenger, and group chat.

arxiv-2108-06207.title: Disentangling Hate in Online Memes Conference: Proceedings of the 29th ACM International Conference on Multimedia; October 20–24, 2021; Virtual Event, China Proceedings of the 29th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM ’21), October 20–24, 2021, Virtual Event, China Price: 15.00 DOI: 10.114
arxiv-2108-06207.creator: Roy Ka-Wei Lee, Rui Cao, Ziqing Fan, Jing Jiang, Wen-Haw Chong
arxiv-2108-06207.description: Abstract . Hateful and offensive content detection has been extensively explored in a single modality such as text. However, such toxic information could also be communicated via multimodal content such as online memes. Therefore, detecting multimodal hateful content has recently garnered much attention in academic and industry research communities.

arxiv-2204-03823.title: Gravitationally Lensed Orphan Afterglows of Gamma-Ray Bursts 2022 Gravitationally Lensed Orphan Afterglows of Gamma-Ray Bursts – References
arxiv-2204-03823.creator: Hao-Xuan Gao, Jin-Jun Geng, Lei Hu, Mao-Kai Hu, Guang-Xuan Lan, Chen-Ming Chang, Song-Bo Zhang, Xiao-Li Zhang, Yong-Feng Huang, Xue-Feng Wu
arxiv-2204-03823.description: Abstract The cosmological nature of gamma-ray bursts (GRBs) implies that a small portion of them could be gravitationally lensed by foreground objects during their propagation. The gravitational lensing effect on the GRB prompt emission and on-axis afterglows has been discussed, and some candidates have been found in the literature.

arxiv-2209-14479.title: Semantics-Guided Object Removal for Facial Images: with Broad Applicability and Robust Style Preservation
arxiv-2209-14479.creator: Jookyung Song, Yeonjin Chang, SeongUk Park, Nojun Kwak
arxiv-2209-14479.description: Abstract Object removal and image inpainting in facial images is a task in which objects that occlude a facial image are specifically targeted, removed, and replaced by a properly reconstructed facial image. Two different approaches utilizing U-net and modulated generator respectively have been widely endorsed for this task for their unique advantages but notwithstanding each method’s innate disadvantages.

arxiv-2307-10780.title: Learned Thresholds Token Merging and Pruning for Vision Transformers
arxiv-2307-10780.creator: Maxim Bonnaerens maxim.bonnaerens@ugent.be, Joni Dambre joni.dambre@ugent.be
arxiv-2307-10780.description: Abstract Vision transformers have demonstrated remarkable success in a wide range of computer vision tasks over the last years. However, their high computational costs remain a significant barrier to their practical deployment. In particular, the complexity of transformer models is quadratic with respect to the number of input tokens.

arxiv-2401-10802.title: Using GMM in Open Cluster Membership: An Insight Journal: Astronomy & \& Computing
arxiv-2401-10802.creator: Md Mahmudunnobe, Priya Hasan, Mudasir Raja, Md Saifuddin, S N Hasan
arxiv-2401-10802.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Md Mahmudunnobe, Priya Hasan, Mudasir Raja, Md Saifuddin, S N Hasan. The unprecedented precision of Gaia has led to a paradigm shift in membership determination of open clusters where a variety of machine learning (ML) models can be employed. In this paper, we apply the unsupervised Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) to a sample of thirteen clusters with varying ages ( l ​ o ​ g ​ t ≈ log\ t\approx 6.38-9.64) and distances (441-5183 pc) from Gaia DR3 data to determine membership.

arxiv-2404-04068.title: Assessing the quality of information extraction
arxiv-2404-04068.creator: Filip Seitl, Tomáš Kovářík, Soheyla Mirshahi, Jan Kryštůfek Rastislav Dujava, Matúš Ondreička, Herbert Ullrich, Petr Gronat Creative Dock
arxiv-2404-04068.description: Abstract Advances in large language models have notably enhanced the efficiency of information extraction from unstructured and semi-structured data sources. As these technologies become integral to various applications, establishing an objective measure for the quality of information extraction becomes imperative. However, the scarcity of labeled data presents significant challenges to this endeavor.

arxiv-2406-18759.title: Quantum-Computing for Corrosion Simulation and Prevention: Workflow and Resource Analysis
arxiv-2406-18759.creator: Nam Nguyen, Thomas W. Watts, Benjamin Link, Kristen S. Williams, Yuval R. Sanders, Samuel J. Elman, Maria Kieferova, Michael J. Bremner, Kaitlyn J. Morrell, Justin Elenewski, Eric B. Isaacs, Samuel D. Johnson, Luke Mathieson, Kevin M. Obenland, Matthew Otten, Rashmi Sundareswara, Adam Holmes
arxiv-2406-18759.description: Abstract Corrosion is a pervasive issue that impacts the structural integrity and performance of materials across various industries, imposing a significant economic impact globally. In fields like aerospace and defense, developing corrosion-resistant materials is critical, but progress is often hindered by the complexities of material-environment interactions.

arxiv-2506-09709.title: Training-Free Voice Conversion with Factorized Optimal Transport
arxiv-2506-09709.creator: Alexander, Assel, Maria
arxiv-2506-09709.description: Abstract This paper introduces Factorized MKL-VC, a training-free modification for kNN-VC pipeline. In contrast with original pipeline, our algorithm performs high quality any-to-any cross-lingual voice conversion with only 5 second of reference audio. MKL-VC replaces kNN regression with a factorized optimal transport map in WavLM embedding subspaces, derived from Monge-Kantorovich Linear solution.

arxiv-2506-19656.title: Video Compression for Spatiotemporal Earth System Data
arxiv-2506-19656.creator: Oscar J. Pellicer-Valero, Cesar Aybar, Gustau Camps Valls
arxiv-2506-19656.description: Abstract Large-scale Earth system datasets, from high-resolution remote sensing imagery to spatiotemporal climate model outputs, exhibit characteristics analogous to those of standard videos. Their inherent spatial, temporal, and spectral redundancies can thus be readily exploited by established video compression techniques. Here, we present xarrayvideo , a Python library for compressing multichannel spatiotemporal datasets by encoding them as videos.

arxiv-2510-00145.title: Approximate Quantum State Preparation with Tree-Based Bayesian Optimization Surrogates
arxiv-2510-00145.creator: Nicholas S. DiBrita, Jason Han, Younghyun Cho, Hengrui Luo, Tirthak Patel
arxiv-2510-00145.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Nicholas S. DiBrita, Jason Han, Younghyun Cho, Hengrui Luo, Tirthak Patel. We study the problem of approximate state preparation on near-term quantum computers, where the goal is to construct a parameterized circuit that reproduces the output distribution of a target quantum state while minimizing resource overhead. This task is especially relevant for near-term algorithms where distributional matching suffices, but it is challenging due to stochastic outputs, limited circuit depth, and a high-dimensional, non-smooth parameter space.

arxiv-2510-08574.title: Fragmentation-limited dust filtration in 2D simulations of planet-disk systems with dust coagulation. Parameter study and implications for the inner disk’s dust mass budget and composition. The Flatiron Institute is a division of the Simons Foundation. The Flatiron Institute is a division of the Sim
arxiv-2510-08574.creator: Thomas Pfeil, Philip J. Armitage, Yan-Fei Jiang (姜燕飞)
arxiv-2510-08574.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Thomas Pfeil, Philip J. Armitage, Yan-Fei Jiang (姜燕飞). Super-thermal gas giant planets or their progenitor cores are known to open deep gaps in protoplanetary disks, which stop large, drifting dust particles on their way to the inner disk. The possible separation of the disk into distinct reservoirs and the resulting dust depletion interior to the gap have important implications for planetesimal formation and the chemical and isotopic composition of the inner regions of protoplanetary disks.

arxiv-2512-18238.title: Sync Without Guesswork: Incomplete Multivariate Time Series Alignment
arxiv-2512-18238.creator: Ding Jia, Jingyu Zhu, Yu Sun, Aoqian Zhang, Shaoxu Song, Haiwei Zhang, Xiaojie Yuan
arxiv-2512-18238.description: Abstract Multivariate time series alignment is critical for ensuring coherent analysis across variables, but missing values and timestamp inconsistencies make this task highly challenging. Existing approaches often rely on prior imputation, which can introduce errors and lead to suboptimal alignments.

arxiv-2602-05733.title: The resurgence of errors in the localization of 𝒩 = 2 \mathcal{N}=2 superconformal Yang-Mills
arxiv-2602-05733.creator: Inês Aniceto, James Ratcliffe, Itamar Yaakov
arxiv-2602-05733.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Inês Aniceto, James Ratcliffe, Itamar Yaakov. We give a physical interpretation for the analytic continuation of the partition function of superconformal SU ( 2 ) \left(2\right) 𝒩 = 2 \mathcal{N}=2 gauge theory on the four-sphere to all values of the Yang-Mills coupling. We show that a well-motivated 2d construction associates two-dimensional unstable instantons to the 4d complex saddles which appear as singularities in the integrand of the supersymmetric localization expression.

plos-pone-0012409.creator: Liuh Ling Goh, Ed Manser
plos-pone-0012409.description: PLOS ONE research article. Rnd3 (RhoE) protein belongs to the unique branch of Rho family GTPases that has low intrinsic GTPase activity and consequently remains constitutively active [1] , [2] . The current consensus is that Rnd1 and Rnd3 function as important antagonists of RhoA signaling primarily by ac

pmc-11397051.title: Rapid Assessment of Metabolomic Fingerprinting of Recycled Sunflower By-Products via DART-HRMS
pmc-11397051.creator: Carmela Zacometti, Anna Lante, Miluska Cisneros, Andrea Massaro, Dasha Mihaylova, Vesela Chalova, Albert Krastanov, Hristo Kalaydzhiev, Giorgia Riuzzi, Alessandra Tata, Severino Segato
pmc-11397051.description: To comply with a more circular and environmentally friendly European common agricultural policy, while also valorising sunflower by-products, an ultrasound assisted extraction (UAE) was tested to optimise ethanol-wash solutes (EWS). Furthermore, the capabilities of DART-HRMS as a rapid and cost-effective tool for determining the biochemical changes after valorisation of these defatted sunflower EWS were investigated.

pmc-11432455.title: Effect of Spermidine on Endothelial Function in Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Mice
pmc-11432455.creator: Hyoseon Kim, Michael P Massett, Francesco Moccia
pmc-11432455.description: Endothelial dysfunction is common in Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE), even in the absence of cardiovascular disease. Evidence suggests that impaired mitophagy contributes to SLE. Mitochondrial dysfunction is also associated with impaired endothelial function. Spermidine, a natural polyamine, stimulates mitophagy by the PINK1–parkin pathway and counters age-associated endothelial dysfunction.

pmc-11600287.title: Burden of selenium deficiency and cost-effectiveness of selenium agronomic biofortification of staple cereals in Ethiopia
pmc-11600287.creator: Abdu Oumer, Edward J. M. Joy, Hugo De Groote, Martin R. Broadley, Dawd Gashu
pmc-11600287.description: Selenium (Se) deficiency among populations in Ethiopia is consistent with low concentrations of Se in soil and crops that could be addressed partly by Se-enriched fertilisers. This study examines the disease burden of Se deficiency in Ethiopia and evaluates the cost-effectiveness of Se agronomic biofortification.

pmc-11653603.title: A Non‐Invasive and DNA‐free Approach to Upregulate Mammalian Voltage‐Gated Calcium Channels and Neuronal Calcium Signaling via Terahertz Stimulation
pmc-11653603.creator: Yuankun Sun, Jinli Geng, Yu Fan, Yangmei Li, Yuan Zhong, Jing Cai, Xiaodong Liu, Shaomeng Wang, Yubin Gong, Chao Chang, Yaxiong Yang, Chunhai Fan
pmc-11653603.description: Mammalian voltage‐gated calcium channels (CaV) play critical roles in cardiac excitability, synaptic transmission, and gene transcription. Dysfunctions in CaV are implicated in a variety of cardiac and neurodevelopmental disorders. Current pharmacological approaches to enhance CaV activity are limited by off‐target effects, drug metabolism issues, cytotoxicity, and imprecise modulation.

pmc-11716742.title: Measuring and reporting adherence in multimodal interventions to prevent cognitive decline
pmc-11716742.creator: Natalia Soldevila‐Domenech, Amaia Ayala‐García, Laura Forcano, Mariagnese Barbera, Jenni Lehtisalo, Tiia Ngandu, Alina Solomon, Rafael de la Torre
pmc-11716742.description: BackgroundAdhering to lifestyle‐based multimodal interventions to prevent cognitive decline is crucial for their success, but limited evidence exists on determinants of adherence. This gap may stem from inconsistent adherence measurement and reporting across studies. Additionally, uncertainties persist regarding the optimal intervention intensity needed for meaningful cognitive benefits.

pmc-12511184.title: Emerging Therapeutic Approaches to Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma: Advances and Future Directions
pmc-12511184.creator: Chengwei Peng, Paul E Oberstein
pmc-12511184.description: Opinion StatementPancreatic adenocarcinoma remains a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Although surgery can be curable for a subset of patients, the five-year overall survival remains less than 15%. Despite extensive molecular characterization of pancreatic cancer, cytotoxic chemotherapy has served as the major component in therapeutic management.

pmc-12700661.title: Improving resident physicians' knowledge of the ABCDEF bundle through a multimodal teaching intervention
pmc-12700661.creator: Priscilla Garcia, Katherine M Quiñones Cruz, Taylor Ramsaroop, Israel Acosta Sánchez, Christian Ascoli, Tirsa M Ferrer Marrero
pmc-12700661.description: gement and empowerment) is an intervention that can be applied to all Intensive Care Unit (ICU) patients.1,2 The Society of Critical Care Medicine (SCCM) recommends its daily implementation to maximize patient outcomes.1,3 It decreases in-hospital mortality, delirium, physical restraint usage, ICU readmissions, and discharges to rehabilitation facilities.

pmc-12738679.title: A multi-compartment homogenized perfusion model for deforming hierarchical vasculature
pmc-12738679.creator: Jannes Hohl, Adnan Ebrahem, Etienne Jessen, Marco F. P. ten Eikelder, Dominik Schillinger
pmc-12738679.description: The simulation of tissue perfusion based on highly detailed synthetic vasculature that often consists of multiple supplying and draining trees with millions of vascular segments is computationally expensive. Converting highly detailed synthetic vasculature into a homogenized continuum flow representation offers a computationally efficient alternative.

pmc-12963664.title: Prognostic Value of Neutrophil-to-Lymphocyte Ratio in Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer Treated with Neoadjuvant Concurrent Chemoradiotherapy and Robotic-Assisted Resection
pmc-12963664.creator: Yen-Cheng Chen, Tsung-Kun Chang, Wei-Chih Su, Yung-Sung Yeh, Po-Jung Chen, Tzu-Chieh Yin, Ching-Chun Li, Ching-Wen Huang, Hsiang-Lin Tsai, Jaw-Yuan Wang
pmc-12963664.description: BackgroundThe long-term outcomes of robotic-assisted surgery and the prognostic significance of the pretreatment neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR) in locally advanced rectal cancer (LARC) remain uncertain. This study aimed to assess the long-term outcomes of patients with LARC undergoing robotic-assisted surgery and to determine the prognostic value of pretreatment NLR.

pmc-13145184.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026OT109 EARLY AGGRESSIVE STRATEGY FOR TREATMENT OF LIPID-LOWERING IN ACUTE ISCHEMIC STROKE DELIVERED WITH ENDOVASCULAR THERAPY FOR LARGE ARTERY OCCLUSION (EAST-LDL), PROTOCOL AND UPDATE
pmc-13145184.creator: Yue Zhang, Chen Chen, Yaping Xiao, Yihai Wang, Zhengyu Huang, Feifeng Liu, Hao Shen, Haiyi Feng, Gang Li
pmc-13145184.description: Background and aimsDespite successful endovascular thrombectomy, a substantial proportion of patients with acute ischaemic stroke due to large-vessel occlusion fail to achieve favourable functional outcomes. Current standard-of-care primarily focuses on reperfusion and lacks effective adjunctive strategies targeting secondary injury mechanisms.

pmc-13315378.title: Pediatric parotid mucoepidermoid carcinoma: a case report
pmc-13315378.creator: Gashaw Arega, Abdurrhman Kedir Hamza, Leul Adane, Mesay Tilahun, Fitsum A Gemechu, Adino Melkamu Gobez
pmc-13315378.description: Salivary gland neoplasms are rare, comprising less than 5% of pediatric head and neck tumors, with mucoepidermoid carcinoma (MEC) being the most common malignant type. MEC in the parotid gland is exceedingly rare in children. Histologically, MEC tumors consist of squamous cells, mucus-secreting cells, and lymphoid infiltration, reflecting their complex cellular composition.

pmc-13530416.title: Potential Iatrogenic Harms From Medicinal Cannabis Prescribing in Australia: A Case Series
pmc-13530416.creator: Richard Bradlow, James Sorensen, Anna Cunningham, Sean Daugherty, Eric Hadinata, Ferghal Armstrong, Nazila Jamshidi
pmc-13530416.description: IntroductionMedicinal cannabis prescribing in Australia has increased markedly, including for psychiatric indications where evidence of benefit is limited and of low certainty. The rise of highly commercialised prescribing models has raised concerns regarding patient safety, particularly for those with pre‐existing psychiatric or addiction vulnerabilities.

uslaw-usc-t10-s1076d.title: 10 U.S.C. § 1076d — TRICARE program: TRICARE Reserve Select coverage for members of the Selected Reserve
uslaw-usc-t10-s1076d.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s1076d.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part II (Personnel); Chapter 55 (Medical And Dental Care). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Eligibility.— (1) Except as provided in paragraph (2), a member of the Selected Reserve of the Ready Reserve of a reserve component of the armed forces is eligible for health benefits under TRICARE Reserve Select as provided in this section.
